scenarios.name: Dodge the Matrix code
scenarios.summary: Look up, dodge the falling code for 62 s
scenarios.description: Where tele_matrix_whiteroom puts the humans (td_matrix_boss), 46 s after the dial-up phone (trigger_dialup, replayed silently up to its layer swap: loc_matrix_boss_layer shown, the doors hidden). At +47 s rushb_script's StartMiniGame3 (scripts/rushb.vjs, ported) counts 62 s down and checks every 0.01 s that a human is within 300 u of the floor's centre. From +52.2 s timer_matrixboss picks, every 0.6-1 s (0.4-0.8 at +56, 0.3-0.7 at +71, 0.2-0.6 at +96, off at +106), a random piece from each of the six case_matrixboss_* rings: a code*_maker spawns a digit (func_movelinear, 1500 u down at 400 u/s) carrying tele_code*, which sends you to td_matrixboss_jail. Out of the radius the script fires minigame3_failed; at 0 it fires minigame3_success: the win. The last hold after it is not part of this stage.
